attempts.text:
**The window starts on the anchor.** Column 0, `rpsT`, is spine: carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls, named in 99% at 0.03 bits. Then column 1, a fork, is the most hesitant column of the window at 1.97 bits, named in 50%, in a region of plasticity in 23% of calls; its branch carries a fimbrial family protein, an IS1-like element transposase and espX1.

**A short spine follows.** Columns 2 to 4, `nhaR`, `nhaA` and `mokC`, are carried by 96% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 23 to 32% of calls, named in 85 to 92%. Column 5 is a fork, in a region of plasticity in 31% of calls, named in 69% at 0.58 bits, carrying a transposase and an outer membrane protein OmpK.

**The long spine runs from `dnaJ` to `lplA`.** Columns 6 to 37, carried by 91 to 96% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0.2 to 18% of calls, named in 92 to 99%, with the fewest named at `ytjB`, 92%. Columns 39 to 49, `deoD` to `prfC`, [[deoxyribonucleotide and threonine metabolism]], are named in 90 to 99%, fewest at `deoD`, 90%; column 38 is a fork, named in 88%.

**The last 30 columns are fork and variable columns.** Columns 50 to 79 are in a region of plasticity in 6 to 57% of calls, named in 74 to 97%, fewest at column 57, 74%, most hesitant at `yjiJ`, 0.72 bits. Two parallel branches run there: `hpaR` to `hpaD` through columns 68 to 71, [[homoprotocatechuate degradation]], carried by 26 to 27% of chromosomes, and `hpaH` to a 4-hydroxyphenylacetate 3-monooxygenase through columns 73 to 78, carried by 14 to 24%.

**The model names persistent genes readily and hesitates inside plasticity.** Over the window it names 92% of genes at 0.32 bits; persistent calls are named in 98% at 0.14 bits, shell in 73% at 0.96 bits, cloud in 29% at 3.20 bits. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.00 against 0.20 bits, and names fewer genes, 76% against 95%.

label: rpsT
facts:
WINDOW: the rpsT window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor rpsT, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,690 to 3,769 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying rpsT once); 43,200 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.32 bits on average (perplexity 1.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 34,692 calls, named 98%, 0.14 bits; shell 8,114 calls, named 73%, 0.96 bits; cloud 394 calls, named 29%, 3.20 bits. Outside an RGP 36,727 calls, named 95%, 0.20 bits; inside an RGP 6,473 calls, named 76%, 1.00 bits. Columns: 47 spine, 17 fork, 16 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.00 against 0.20 bits) and names fewer genes (76% against 95%); 6,473 of the 43,200 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 1 ("fimbrial family protein") 1.97 bits, RGP 23%; column 79 (yjiJ) 0.72 bits, RGP 52%; column 66 (lgoT) 0.69 bits, RGP 37%. The 10 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 86%, 0.53 bits on average; the other 70 columns: named 93%, 0.29 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 50-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 6-57%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: rpsT. named 99%; 0.03 bits.
2. column 1 fork: RGP 23%. named 50%; 1.97 bits.
   1: "fimbrial family protein" S 52%; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 29%, espX1 S 29%
3. columns 2-4 (3 columns) spine: share 96%, all P, RGP 23-32%. Genes: nhaR, nhaA "Na+/H+ antiporter NhaA", mokC. named 85-92% (mean 89%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 4 (mokC), named 85%, 0.61 bits.
4. column 5 fork: RGP 31%. named 69%; 0.58 bits.
   5: "transposase" S 45%; also "outer membrane protein OmpK" S 18%
5. columns 6-37 (32 columns) spine: share 91-96%, all P, RGP 0.2-18%. Genes: dnaJ, dnaK "molecular chaperone DnaK", yaaI "DUF2541 family protein", msyB, satP, mog, tal, yaaJ "alanine:cation symporter family pro…", yaaA "peroxide stress protein YaaA", yaaX "DUF2502 domain-containing protein", thrC, thrB, thrA, thrL "thr operon leader peptide", yjtD "TrmH family RNA methyltransferase", yjjY "protein YjjY", arcA, creD, creC "two-component system sensor histidi…", creB, creA, robA, gpmB, yjjX "inosine/xanthosine triphosphatase", trpR, sltY, ettA, nadR, radA, serB, ytjB "YtjB family periplasmic protein", lplA. named 92-99% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 36 (ytjB), named 92%, 0.36 bits.
6. column 38 fork: RGP 9%. named 88%; 0.43 bits.
   38: "sigma factor-like helix-turn-helix DNA-…" S 58%; also yjjJ S 16%
7. columns 39-49 (11 columns) spine: share 95-96%, all P, RGP 1-9%. Genes: deoD, deoB, deoA "thymidine phosphorylase", deoC, yjjI "glycyl radical enzyme domain-contai…", yjjW "4Fe-4S cluster-binding domain-conta…", yjjV "metal-dependent hydrolase", yjjU "patatin-like phospholipase family p…", ytjA "DUF1328 domain-containing protein", osmY, prfC. named 90-99% (mean 96%), fewest named at column 39 (deoD), named 90%; most hesitant at column 41 (deoA), 0.36 bits.
8. columns 50-79 (30 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 6-57%. named 74-97% (mean 88%), fewest named at column 57, named 74%; most hesitant at column 79, 0.72 bits.
   a second branch of 4 families through columns 68-71, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 26-27%, all S; the branch's families: hpaR, hpaG, hpaE, hpaD
   a second branch of 6 families through columns 73-78, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 14-24%, all S; the branch's families: hpaH, hpaI, hpaX, hpaA, hpaB, "4-hydroxyphenylacetate 3-monooxygenase…"
   50 fork: yjjG P 83% "pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase"; also "DinI-like family protein" S 12%
   columns 51-58 variable, share 79-83%, all P: rimI 83%, holD 83%, rsmC 83%, yjjZ "DUF1435 family protein" 83%, fhuF 83%, bglJ 79%, yjjQ "helix-turn-helix domain-containing…" 79%, yjjP "threonine/serine ThrE exporter fami…" 83%
   59 fork: yjjB P 82% "threonine/serine exporter"; also "C40 family peptidase" S 10%
   60 fork: dnaT P 82% "DnaT-like ssDNA-binding domain-cont…"; also "phage minor tail protein L" S 10%
   columns 61-67 variable, share 64-82%, 5 P, 2 S: dnaC 82%, yjjA "DUF2501 domain-containing protein Y…" 82%, opgB 82%, lgoD "L-galactonate oxidoreductase" 80%, lgoR 75%, lgoT 64%, tsr 79%
   68 fork: btsT P 61%
   69 fork: yjiX P 58% "YbdD/YjiX family protein"; also "cation:proton antiporter" S 12%
   70 fork: yjiA P 54% "GTPase"; also "TRAP transporter substrate-binding prot…" S 12%
   71 fork: "BrnA antitoxin family protein" S 36%; also "TRAP transporter small permease subunit" S 13%
   72 fork: "BrnT family toxin" S 30%; also "TRAP transporter large permease" S 12%
   73 fork: mdtM S 28%
   74 fork: yjiN P 28%
   75 fork: yjiM P 25% "double-cubane-cluster-containing an…"; also "5-carboxymethyl-2-hydroxymuconate Delta…" S 24%
   76 fork: yjiL P 26% "BadF/BadG/BcrA/BcrD ATPase family p…"
   77 fork: ytiA P 24% "DUF3343 domain-containing protein"
   78 fork: yjiK P 21% "SdiA-regulated domain-containing pr…"
   79 variable: yjiJ P 17% "YbfB/YjiJ family MFS transporter"
